Establish or observe one exactly matching shared service owner.

Usage:
  nix run .#ensure -- --task <id> --until-step <path> [options]

Options:
  --slot <number>             Select a declared project slot
  --task <id>                 Select the declared root composite task
  --until-step <path>         Await one canonical root task step
  --timeout-ms <number>       Set the runtime operation timeout in milliseconds
  --wait-timeout-ms <number>  Set the positive caller-local observation timeout in milliseconds
  -h, --help                  Show this help
